newsitem.title: MEXICO: HEALTHY FINANCES ESSENTIAL FOR GROWTH -ZEDILLO.
newsitem.headline: HEALTHY FINANCES ESSENTIAL FOR GROWTH -ZEDILLO.

text.p: President Ernesto Zedillo said on Tuesday Mexico must hold to its policy of sound public finances so as to stimulate investment and create jobs that will sustain economic growth.

"We must keep healthy public finances, because if we do not, inflation will grow, damaging especially those who have less, and interest rates will trend upwards, slowing investment and job creation," he said.
In a speech to Mexico's Chamber of Mining, Zedillo said that maintaining responsible fiscal and monetary policies was indispensible for achieving sustained and vigorous economic growth.

He said the government would not slide backwards in its task of maintaining sound public finances, which he said would help social development especially among groups and regions that are falling behind.

His comments come after opposition politicians, newly empowered after making big gains in July 6 elections, joined forces to weaken control over legislation by Zedillo's Institutional Revolutionary Party in the lower house of Congress.

Already they are clamouring for a cut in value added tax to 10 percent from its current 15 percent level, though the government has said this would blow a 25 billion peso hole in the public purse. ((-- Veronica Galan, Mexico City newsroom +525 728 7905))
